question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

Maladroit
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **Skillful**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Maladroit** means lacking skill or dexterity, being clumsy or awkward in action. (अकुशल, अनाड़ी)
 
 
• **Example:** His maladroit handling of the situation caused confusion among the team.
 
 
• **Skillful** refers to having expertise, proficiency, or dexterity in performing tasks. (कुशल)
 
 
• **Example:** She is a skillful artist who creates breathtaking paintings.
 
 
• Hence, the antonym of **"Maladroit"** is **"Skillful."**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Skillful**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Clumsy** (अकुशल, अनाड़ी): Lacking grace, skill, or dexterity in movement or action. 
 
 
• **Example:** His clumsy attempt to fix the vase ended up breaking it even more.
 
 
 
• **Awkward** (अटपटा, असहज): Causing or feeling embarrassment or difficulty in handling situations. 
 
 
• **Example:** There was an awkward silence during the meeting when no one knew what to say.
 
 
 
• **Inept** (अयोग्य, अकुशल): Not suitable or capable; lacking skill. 
 
 
• **Example:** His inept performance during the presentation disappointed his boss.
